freshness.policy: Change-driven: any newer cited source review invalidates the question snapshot. No calendar-based expiry; re-retrieve and independently review after documentation/taxonomy changes. Fresh is relative to checked-in evidence, not a claim of perpetual correctness.

sources.title: Study guide for Exam AI-200: Developing AI Cloud Solutions on Azure
sources.shortSummary: Fresh MCP retrieval confirms the unchanged undated four-domain, nine-skill, 27-subskill AI-200 outline and its stated weights. The original undated content identity is retained; this retrieval does not establish exam GA status or implementation behavior.

sources.title: Define ConfigMaps for application settings
sources.shortSummary: configMapKeyRef/envFrom and file-volume consumption; ordinary mounted files refresh, environment values need restart and subPath does not auto-refresh. Application reload behavior is supplied explicitly in stems.

sources.title: Implement secrets for sensitive data
sources.shortSummary: secretKeyRef injection and describe secret metadata/key inspection without secret values. CSI/App Configuration product links are not used without fresh separate supporting retrieval.

sources.title: Create Kubernetes deployment manifests
sources.shortSummary: Deployment replicas, image references and matching template labels; CPU/memory requests guide scheduling. Excludes recommended fixed production replica counts and false equivalence of CPU/memory limit behavior.

sources.title: Expose applications in Azure Kubernetes Services
sources.shortSummary: Service selectors, client port versus targetPort and documented ClusterIP/NodePort/LoadBalancer/ExternalName purposes. Public LoadBalancer examples are not universal claims about internal load balancers.

sources.title: Deploy applications to Azure Kubernetes Services
sources.shortSummary: kubectl apply submits desired state asynchronously; inspect readiness and actual application requests; previous-container logs and scheduling event inspection. No automatic ACR authorization assumption.

sources.title: Deploy containers to Azure App Service
sources.shortSummary: Linux App Service image selection and explicit registry authentication; changing image tags and same-tag push pickup via restart or configured registry webhook. No ARM-audience requirement is inferred from this unit.

sources.title: Configure container runtime behavior
sources.shortSummary: Conventional Linux custom-container CMD override, WEBSITES_PORT routing, and enabled /home storage across restart and scale-out. Excludes sidecar behavior and broad health-check timing guarantees.

sources.title: Configure application settings
sources.shortSummary: Runtime app settings, typed connection-string prefixes, and Key Vault reference prerequisites and resolution. Slot stickiness is documented but not used to recreate the known cross-bank duplicate.

sources.title: Observe and troubleshoot containerized apps
sources.shortSummary: Container stdout/stderr logs, SCM Environment and mounted-file views, and distinction between SCM and the actual application container. SSH requires image support; no secret values should be displayed.

sources.title: Explore Container Apps environments
sources.shortSummary: Environment networking/logging/lifecycle boundaries and internal versus external ingress. Optional CLI preview extension flag is not used or treated as ordinary baseline functionality.

sources.title: Deploy a container app using the Azure CLI and YAML
sources.shortSummary: CLI create/update flows, image changes creating revisions and YAML as the configuration source overriding other configuration flags. Application/resource selectors remain necessary.

sources.title: Configure runtime settings with environment variables and secrets
sources.shortSummary: Nonsensitive environment values versus CLI secretref and template secretRef; externalized secret values and template configuration. No invented Key Vault CLI syntax is used.

sources.title: Configure image pull authentication for private registries
sources.shortSummary: Registry authentication is separate from application configuration. An assigned identity with registry pull permission must be selected in registry configuration; username/password remains an alternative for suitable registries.

sources.title: Verify deployments with logs and status
sources.shortSummary: Console versus system logs and app/revision/replica inspection during deployment verification. Successful image provisioning alone is not application health.

sources.title: Update images and manage revisions safely
sources.shortSummary: Image updates, per-revision configuration comparison and deactivation preserving investigation evidence. No unsupported revision deletion command or retention guarantee is authored.

sources.title: Monitor logs and troubleshoot issues
sources.shortSummary: Revision-specific failure isolation by console logs and configuration comparison; safe correlation/build metadata without raw sensitive prompts.

sources.title: Configure health probes and troubleshoot failures
sources.shortSummary: Readiness gates request routing while liveness failure restarts replicas. Probe paths and initial delays should match measured application behavior; YAML patterns are not treated as executable deployment validation.

sources.title: Monitor application logs and metrics
sources.shortSummary: Explicit namespace and container selection for logs; metrics-server prerequisite for kubectl top; combine utilization with application and event evidence.

sources.title: Troubleshoot pods and services
sources.shortSummary: Pod events distinguish pull, startup and scheduling failures; Service selector/targetPort/EndpointSlice checks; permanent repairs belong in manifests rather than container shells.

sources.title: Verify service connectivity and endpoints
sources.shortSummary: Service-to-Pod endpoint inspection, local port-forward testing and separate verification of public load-balancer/ingress paths. A successful local tunnel is not proof of external connectivity.

sources.title: Configure scale rules
sources.shortSummary: Scale limits, HTTP/TCP/resource triggers and independent rule signals. Excludes disputed HTTP averaging, generalized billing and unsupported precise scale-step assertions.

sources.title: Implement event-driven scaling with KEDA
sources.shortSummary: Service Bus queue versus subscription metadata, backlog threshold, supported authentication mappings, and Event Hubs consumer-group partition/lag limits. Excludes the unit’s inconsistent message-throughput example.

sources.title: Apply KEDA scalers for custom workloads
sources.shortSummary: Cron active-window baseline combined with reactive rules selects the highest requested count; ScaledObject-to-Container Apps mapping. Non-Learn KEDA links are not source approvals; Kafka parameter examples are not used.

sources.title: Choose and apply revision modes
sources.shortSummary: Template versus application changes; ready single-mode handoff; multiple-mode traffic and ordinary revision labels; independent per-revision replica minima. No preview deployment-label mode, retention limit or release-status inference.

sources.title: Registries, repositories, and artifacts
sources.shortSummary: Registry/repository/artifact roles; mutable tags, the omitted latest tag, manifests and shared content-addressed layers. Excludes namespace authorization claims and tier-specific capabilities.

sources.title: Build and run images with ACR Tasks
sources.shortSummary: Cloud quick builds, local/Git/tarball context selection, task triggers and run operations, .dockerignore upload reduction and Dockerfile layer caching. Excludes broad public-registry base-trigger compatibility and the erroneous throughput arithmetic example elsewhere.

sources.title: Tag and version images
sources.shortSummary: Stable release-line servicing versus never-reused build references; build and commit metadata; deployed-tag write-enabled command. No claim that write-enabled alone controls deletion, retention exemptions, purge age behavior or feature release status.

sources.title: Implement the Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL SDK
sources.shortSummary: Connects through the root CosmosClient; recommends application-lifetime client reuse, distinguishes lightweight database/container handles, point reads and queries, and create/upsert/replace item operations. Do not use the illustrative if_match snippet or expand account-key security assertions.

sources.title: Query Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL
sources.shortSummary: Documents separate name/value query parameters, partition routing, projection, page size and lazy iteration, array queries, and request-charge observation. No latency or RU number is guaranteed.

sources.title: Store and retrieve embeddings in Azure Cosmos DB
sources.shortSummary: Documents array-valued embeddings; immutable path/type/dimension/metric policies at container creation; float32, float16, int8 and uint8; vector-index types and minimum effective index population. Preserves corrected float16 support but excludes universal negligible-loss or whole-database 50-percent savings claims. Cosine scoring inconsistencies are excluded.

sources.title: Execute vector similarity queries for semantic search
sources.shortSummary: Documents VectorDistance query shape, TOP, projection, same-model query embeddings, and explicit brute-force option. The prose cosine-similarity direction conflicts with default ascending examples; no candidate relies on that scoring interpretation.

sources.title: Combine vector similarity results with metadata filtering
sources.shortSummary: Combines metadata eligibility with vector queries and explicitly targets the partition key. Optimizer-dependent pre/post filtering is not a universal exhaustive-recall or exact result-count guarantee. Hybrid full-text/RRF implementation is not used in this batch.

sources.title: Use the change feed to trigger embedding refresh
sources.shortSummary: Explains lease checkpoint/ownership/failover, push versus scheduled pull processing, selective content-hash-based refresh, and updating the embedding and content hash together. Excludes exactly-once wording, illustrative always-true refresh code, unsupported standalone runtime tables, and malformed pull start flags.

sources.title: Configure range and composite indexes
sources.shortSummary: Documents property order and full-direction reversal for composite ORDER BY, equality-first/range-last composite filtering, per-write index costs, and asynchronous add-before-remove index transformation. No nested-path specificity rule is inferred beyond the actual examples.

sources.title: Tune vector indexes for embedding workloads
sources.shortSummary: Distinguishes exact flat, quantizedFlat and diskANN; 505-dimensional flat limit, 1000-vector effective-index threshold, separation from range indexing, and immutable vector policies. Optional tuning feature-release assertions and generalized prefilter guarantees are excluded.

sources.title: Reduce RU costs with strategic indexing
sources.shortSummary: Relates write costs to indexed paths and actual filter/sort workloads; compares retrieved/output metrics, selective indexing, and asynchronous transformations. Benchmark results must be interpreted for measured data rather than universal cost promises.

sources.title: Choose consistency levels for optimal performance
sources.shortSummary: Documents partition-bound session tokens and explicit handoff between SDK clients, read-your-writes versus weaker consistency, and relative read RU costs. Does not license strengthening an account default per request or promise instant ANN indexing.

sources.title: Connect to PostgreSQL
sources.shortSummary: Documents issued Entra token strings as database passwords, PostgreSQL token resource, native authentication, TLS verification modes, and direct 5432 versus enabled General Purpose/Memory Optimized PgBouncer 6432 endpoints. No username-format generalization is used.

sources.title: Create and manage schemas
sources.shortSummary: Documents typed columns, JSONB, BYTEA, NOT NULL/UNIQUE/foreign keys, composite keys, and table/index separation. Excludes the incorrect claim that RESTRICT is the default referential action and absolute trailing-index-column limitations.

sources.title: Query data
sources.shortSummary: Documents JSONB extraction and containment, keyset pagination with a unique tie-breaker, RETURNING, and ON CONFLICT. The broad SELECT alias statement about GROUP BY/LIMIT is excluded.

sources.title: Integrate SDKs and applications
sources.shortSummary: Documents psycopg parameter tuples, result-fetch modes, connection/cursor context managers, connection and statement timeouts, transient versus syntax/constraint failures, COPY batching, and application pool checkout. External library sites are not admitted sources.

sources.title: Store and query embeddings with pgvector
sources.shortSummary: Documents installed vector extension, dimensioned vector columns, dense/half/sparse representations and distinct distance operators. No omitted extension allowlisting prerequisite or model-specific output guarantee is inferred.

sources.title: Perform fast vector similarity search
sources.shortSummary: Documents IVFFlat data-dependent clustering versus HNSW empty-table construction, runtime probes/search width, and metric/operator-class correspondence. Directly links the exact pgvector performance product article. Excludes universal latency/recall targets.

sources.title: Manage index lifecycle and embedding updates
sources.shortSummary: Documents index progress/usage monitoring, deferred stale-embedding refresh, parallel model columns, table/index sizing and MVCC old row versions. Excludes the invalid 3072-dimensional standard-vector HNSW example, erroneous migration-time arithmetic, and fixed index-size multipliers.

sources.title: Run vector similarity search for semantic retrieval
sources.shortSummary: Documents metadata/index cost-based plan selection, evaluated distance thresholds plus count limits, content projections, multi-aspect and hybrid retrieval. Never assumes every ANN query physically prefilters or that a global threshold fits all corpora.

sources.title: Implement retrieval patterns for RAG pipelines
sources.shortSummary: Documents source/chunk tables, adjacency, token budgets, provenance projections, version filters, and precision/recall evaluation. No flawed DISTINCT/window snippet is reused; citation usefulness does not establish probabilistic confidence.

sources.title: Tune PostgreSQL for pgvector
sources.shortSummary: Distinguishes shared_buffers, per-operation work_mem and nonallocating effective_cache_size; documents measured plans, CPU/memory/I/O and runtime search settings. Explicitly excludes the incorrect quadratic vector-distance dimension-scaling claim and integer-dividing cache-hit snippet.

sources.title: Choose and configure vector indexes
